interactions.name: preview_construction
interactions.action: Expose independent editable pose controls and seat indentation; continuous controls allow accumulated angle beyond 2*pi. Optional reset restores initial transforms and shape.
interactions.expected: Native visible surfaces follow actual owner hierarchy; seat patch visibly deforms while its perimeter stays attached. All behavior labelled parameter preview with physical status not_tested.

review_requirements: Construction-only inspection: assign every native face exactly once while preserving rest geometry, UVs and PBR. Refine the proposed geometric seeds so wheel bodies contain complete rotating rims rather than lower slices, lumbar surfaces and tag follow back, and arm supports remain separate from seat/back surfaces. Keep seat_flex faces exclusively under its deforming root. Record additions against the four reviewed connector budgets.

Using only static preview transforms, inspect visible attachment continuity at minimum, middle and maximum coordinates for height, recline, head_tilt and both arm slides; inspect representative quarter-turn poses for swivel and all caster joints. Confirm the intended native surfaces follow each owner and parent assembly. Use supported root-offset mapping and only the reviewed bounded connectors. These are construction inspections, not physical endpoint, contact or trajectory tests.

Inspect exported MJCF and interactive metadata: swivel and every caster yaw/roll hinge must retain limited=false without range or parameter limits. Preview controls must retain unwrapped accumulated angles beyond 2*pi without actuator angle bounds. Confirm wheel roll acts about its axle and inherits fork yaw; preserve the limited-joint ranges separately.

Construct the coarse seat flex discretization and native skin mapping with valid weights and rest offsets. Through the parameter preview only, show a localized indentation bounded by 0.025 m with an attached perimeter; confirm the patch also follows seat height and swivel and resets to its native rest surface. Label this visible deformation as parameter-driven, with load response and recovery untested.

Save the native-preserving interactive GLB, editable Blender source, MJCF and interactive metadata, then hand off promptly for browser publication. Retain physics_status=not_tested and physics_attempts=0. Do not execute physics.py, simulate, verify_integration, mj_step, contact/load/physical endpoint tests, physical trajectories or full validation loops; do not create physical-pass reports.

interaction_coverage.label: Turn the upper assembly around the pedestal
interaction_coverage.reason: Central cylindrical support aligns with vertical axis in front/rear and both side views; continuous swivel is an editable mechanism prior.

interaction_coverage.label: Raise the complete upper assembly
interaction_coverage.reason: Exposed spindle and lower sleeve support estimated telescoping travel; 0.12 m is a prior, not recovered travel.

interaction_coverage.label: Recline the back and its attached lumbar/head supports
interaction_coverage.reason: Rear spine meets underseat bracket; transverse pivot estimated at bracket, keeping seat and arm owners independent. Preserve initial 90 degree range.

interaction_coverage.label: Rotate the five evidenced wheel assemblies
interaction_coverage.reason: Five separate low geometric clusters coincide with wheel lobes across native views; estimated horizontal axles follow disk thickness direction, not image obliqueness.

interaction_coverage.label: Swivel the caster forks about their stems
interaction_coverage.reason: Separate wheels below spoke ends support a vertical stem rotation prior without observed stops; wheel axles inherit fork yaw.

interaction_coverage.label: Tilt the head support
interaction_coverage.reason: Separate curved head pad and narrow neck support a bounded transverse adjustment prior.

interaction_coverage.label: Raise the arm supports
interaction_coverage.reason: Long straight arm uprights support a coarse telescoping prior; estimated travel is editable.

interaction_coverage.label: Indent the central seating textile
interaction_coverage.reason: Ribbed contoured seating span is visibly distinct from its rigid rim. Build actual nonrigid skin binding; preview indentation is not a physical result.

interaction_coverage.label: Additional support coverings
interaction_coverage.reason: Seat receives active binding; other coverings retain geometry and follow their owners.
